import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
occupation_sleep = data.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
ax1.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors[0])
ax1.set_xlabel('Avg Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontweight='bold')
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=8)

# 2. Quality of Sleep vs Stress Level
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
scatter = ax2.scatter(data['Stress Level'], data['Quality of Sleep'], 
                     c=data['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Stress Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Stress Level', fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2, label='Age')

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = data['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors[:len(bmi_counts)], startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontweight='bold')

# 4. Physical Activity Level by Age Group
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
data['Age Group'] = pd.cut(data['Age'], bins=[0, 30, 40, 50, 100], 
                            labels=['<30', '30-40', '40-50', '50+'])
age_activity = data.groupby('Age Group')['Physical Activity Level'].mean()
ax4.bar(age_activity.index, age_activity.values, color=colors[1])
ax4.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax4.set_ylabel('Avg Physical Activity Level')
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity by Age Group', fontweight='bold')

# 5. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
sleep_disorder = data['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
ax5.bar(range(len(sleep_disorder)), sleep_disorder.values, color=colors[2])
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(sleep_disorder)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(sleep_disorder.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count')
ax5.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontweight='bold')

# 6. Heart Rate vs Daily Steps
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
ax6.scatter(data['Daily Steps'], data['Heart Rate'], 
           c=data['Physical Activity Level'], cmap='coolwarm', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate')
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps', fontweight='bold')

# 7. Sleep Duration Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax7.hist(data['Sleep Duration'], bins=15, color=colors[3], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax7.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution', fontweight='bold')
ax7.axvline(data['Sleep Duration'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label='Mean')
ax7.legend()

# 8. Gender distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
gender_counts = data['Gender'].value_counts()
ax8.bar(gender_counts.index, gender_counts.values, color=colors[4:6])
ax8.set_xlabel('Gender')
ax8.set_ylabel('Count')
ax8.set_title('Gender Distribution', fontweight='bold')

# 9. Stress Level by BMI Category
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
bmi_stress = data.groupby('BMI Category')['Stress Level'].mean().sort_values()
ax9.barh(bmi_stress.index, bmi_stress.values, color=colors[5])
ax9.set_xlabel('Average Stress Level')
ax9.set_title('Stress Level by BMI Category', fontweight='bold')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', 
             fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
